text: APPROVE. The extraction into `TryList`, `ReadFiles` and `EnqueueRealDirectories` keeps the original control flow (the same `continue`/`break` points, the same unread bookkeeping, and subdirectories still queued after the file cap is hit), and it drops `Files` well under 15. The `CHA0004` pragma now wraps the new catch blocks, so the build should stay clean. I could only read the diff, not build it, so the approval assumes the types of `files` and `unread` in the unseen part of `Files` match the new helper signatures.
